newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes maintain losses, Louisiana grades dive.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes maintain losses, Louisiana grades dive.

text.p: Moderate declines for U.S. crudes continued into the late stages Friday, while losses in key Louisiana sweet grades accelerated, traders said.

Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James nosedived into negative territory, completing what has been a dramatic reversal since early Thursday. Traders said the LLS was now valued at 15 cents below the West Texas Intermediate/Cushing marker, after having topped out Thursday close to 90 cts over the WTI.
Heavy refiner interest in clearing deals ahead of the holiday week and Jan pipeline scheduling, combined with a new open arbitrage for Brent barrels have pressured the LLS.
